description: Redacted OR-G0 spike fixtures for OpenRouter native Responses and Anthropic Messages.

endpoint_binding.proof: All five captures returned HTTP 200 with a stealth/ox-alpha response id and matching model field. The catalog entry reports zero prompt and zero completion price; OR-G1 must revalidate this evidence before every request and refuse dispatch when the freshness bound is exceeded.

codex.verification: Codex Codex CLI accepts arbitrary header names via its provider config; OR-G1 wires the gateway to consume and strip x-reverso-capability before the adapter dispatches. The capability is generated at attended launcher issuance and never reaches OpenRouter or any persistent artifact.

claude.verification: Claude Code launcher accepts header overrides through ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS; OR-G1 sets x-reverso-capability on every Anthropic Messages request. The gateway consumes and strips it before adapter dispatch.

claude_alias_grammar.rationale: Claude Code aliases are catalog-scoped and exact-match; encoding uses base64url without padding to avoid underscore collisions with Anthropic's own `claude-*` namespace. The launcher catalog maps each alias back to the exact upstream `author/model` bytes without any tail parsing.

responses_replay_grammar.rationale: OpenRouter Responses is stateless. Reverso owns the full typed chain in local storage and materializes instructions, reasoning, tools, tool calls/results, images, ordering, and identifiers before the second upstream request. Incomplete, canceled, or unknown chains fail locally; text-only replay is forbidden.
